module: Simple telemetry recorder: every graphics frame (when recording is active) it stores timestamp, position, speed, throttle, brake, steering, parking brake and G forces (sensors.gx2/gy2), then saveDataToDisk writes it all to a CSV file `telemetryData_HH-MM-SS.csv`. Handy for a modder who wants to export a driving session.
notes: CSV columns: frame, timestamp, position, velocity, throttle, brake, steering, parkingbrake, gForceX, gForceY. The position is a string "(x,y,z)" (quoted in the CSV because it contains commas). The line ends with an extra comma; line endings \r\n.
timestamp = sum of the dt received (simulation seconds), velocity = norm of obj:getVelocity() (m/s).
The file is created with a relative path (the game's working directory, not a dedicated user folder). The line order comes from pairs() on an indexed array, so normally ascending but not guaranteed.

saveDataToDisk stops recording, writes, then calls onInit() which clears the data. It returns false if the file cannot be opened (and in that case does not clear the data); otherwise it returns nothing.
escapeCSV crashes if a value is nil (e.g. sensors.gx2 missing).

startRecording.desc: Enables recording: updateGFX adds a data point every frame. Does not reset the data (use onInit/onReset or saveDataToDisk for that).

stopRecording.desc: Pauses recording without clearing the data already collected.

saveDataToDisk.desc: Stops recording and writes the collected data to `telemetryData_<time>.csv`, then resets the state.

returns.desc: false if the file could not be opened, nil otherwise.

updateGFX.desc: Called every graphics frame (extensions.hook('updateGFX')). If recording is active, adds a data point.

dt.desc: Time step in seconds, added to the timestamp.

onInit.desc: Hook called on vehicle initialization: clears the data, resets the index and the timestamp to zero and stops recording.

onReset.desc: Hook called on vehicle reset; same function as onInit (clears the data and stops recording).
